description: The three demo scenarios for the video, in recording order. Used by scripts/demo_rehearsal.py and described step by step in demo/README.md. All messages are written for this project.

scenarios.title: Obvious scam: fake government agent demands $500 in gift cards
scenarios.message: This is Officer Collins with the IRS. You owe $500 in back taxes. You must pay in gift cards within 30 minutes or a warrant will be issued for your arrest.

steps.note: This is a scam, Mum. The IRS never asks for gift cards. I'll call you tonight.

scenarios.title: Legitimate but unusual: $350 deposit to a new contractor
scenarios.message: Hi Margaret, this is Mike from Gutter Pros. As we discussed on Saturday, here is the invoice for the deposit on the gutter repair (invoice #1042 attached). We can start next Tuesday. Thanks!

scenarios.title: Contextual scam: polite bank 'fraud team' asks to move $300 to a protected account
scenarios.message: Good afternoon, this is Daniel from the Fraud Prevention Team at your bank. We noticed unusual sign-in activity on your account. As a precaution, please move $300 to the protected account our security team has set up in your name: Secure Holdings LLC. We will return it once the review is complete. Thank you for your cooperation.

steps.body: Did you speak to this person on the phone?
No, it was a text message. It said it was from my bank.

steps.note: Banks never ask you to move money. Please call the number on the back of your card.
